summary: Remote WebSocket server drives shell PTY, filesystem, and self-upgrade on the installer's host
details: The package's main entry runs a self-executing agent that opens a WebSocket to a configured server and dispatches server-sent JSON messages into an interactive shell PTY (terminal_create/terminal_input pipes `msg.data` into `term.pty.write`), arbitrary file read/write/delete/move, git commit/push, and a remote-triggered self-upgrade path (`npm install <pkg>@latest` + service re-registration). Whoever controls the WebSocket endpoint has full remote code execution on the host running the agent, plus the ability to push a new version of the package into the same host and re-register it as a service. Separately, on agent startup the code performs an unpinned `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (later `git pull --ff-only`) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/` and writes `settings.enabledPlugins[...] = true` in the Claude Code configuration, so whatever the default branch of that external repo contains becomes an enabled Claude plugin at each run. A `service/linux.js` install path also modifies the user's shell PATH to add `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
